fields.climate: mild winters, cool summers; usually overcast; foggy, windy
fields.terrain: rugged, rocky, some low peaks; cliffs along most of coast
fields.hazards: strong winds and heavy rains can occur throughout the year
fields.resources: fish, whales, hydropower, possible oil and gas
fields.farm: milk, potatoes, lamb/mutton, sheepskins, sheep offal, beef, sheep fat, beef offal, cattle hides, beef suet
fields.industries: fishing, fish processing, tourism, small ship repair and refurbishment, handicrafts
fields.languages: Faroese 93.8% (derived from Old Norse), Danish 3.2%, other 3%
fields.religions: Christian 87% (predominantly Evangelical Lutheran), other 0.9%, none 3.7%, unspecified 8.9%

system.text: parliamentary democracy (Faroese Parliament); part of the Kingdom of Denmark

fields.regions: 29 first-order municipalities Eidhi, Eystur, Famjin, Fuglafjordhur, Fugloy, Hov, Husavik, Hvalba, Hvannasund, Klaksvik, Kunoy, Kvivik, Nes, Porkeri, Runavik, Sandur, Sjovar, Skalavik, Skopun, Skuvoy, Sorvagur, Sumba, Sunda, Torshavn, Tvoroyri, Vagar, Vagur, Vestmanna, Vidhareidhi
